patch_scope: Checker fixture and diagnostics only. Carries the 073 path-classification repair and FP64 inertia-chain gates, while restoring the validated invalid adaptive-owner sentinel, approaching relative point velocity, and raw sample failure diagnostics from the 069 fixture correction. No production solver or contact physics changes.

merged_corrections.adaptive_owner: proxy_.adaptiveObjectIndex=NM_INVALID_INDEX to avoid treating FEM object 0 as the rigid body's adaptive owner
merged_corrections.approach_direction: box point velocity is authored so the fixed node approaches the outward contact normal; a dot-product assertion verifies the sign
merged_corrections.sample_failure: invalid status/sample/branch prints raw sample and state fields, marks the result failed, and continues independent cases; it never promotes the missing sample
merged_corrections.inertia_sample_failure: prints raw sample details and returns FAIL instead of throwing before diagnostics

reference_fixture_overlay.merged_only: adaptive owner invalidation, approaching body velocity with dot assertion, raw invalid-sample/inertia diagnostics and fail-closed continuation; its older path and inertia code were not copied

retained_073_gates.path_oracle: FP64 sampled path oracle and production certificate classification are retained; sampled clearance is not treated as a swept certificate
retained_073_gates.contact_operator: A=-dR; stable-feature and max-stiffness-branch checks remain
retained_073_gates.inertia_chain: FP32-bound source fields promoted to FP64; FP64 derivative threshold 1e-6 and production-vs-FP64 threshold 1e-3 remain; FP32 FD may remain inconclusive

validation.native: PENDING root-controlled; no GPU run performed by overlay author

cli_regression.purpose: Catch restoring a probe binary/source that drops the selector-5 option from help output; this is a no-step CLI test.
